stages.name: static-source-preflight
acceptance: Resolve all required pins and exact PEFT source before execution.
Record upstream PeftWarning behavior without claiming it rejects writes.
Keep explicit-state-dict provenance UNKNOWN rather than inferring completeness.

stages.name: gathered-export-reference
acceptance: Create a correctly gathered LoRA adapter on a fixed synthetic or public non-secret fixture.
Verify every serialized lora_A and lora_B tensor is at least 2-D and non-empty.
Read immutable adapter bytes back and load them against the exact base-model and adapter configuration binding.

stages.name: ungathered-shard-negative
acceptance: Create controlled one-dimensional and zero-sized lora_A or lora_B shard cases under ZeRO-3 and or FSDP.
Require the pinned upstream inferred-state-dict path to emit PeftWarning.
Prove the warning does not itself prevent adapter files from being written.

stages.name: scope-and-bypass
acceptance: Prove explicitly supplied state_dict bypasses the heuristic and remains UNKNOWN rather than PASS.
Prove legitimate one-dimensional DoRA magnitude vectors and AdaLoRA lora_E values are not treated as malformed lora_A or lora_B tensors.
Record adapter method and provenance class in the receipt.

stages.name: candidate-szl-prepublication-integrity
acceptance: Evaluate, but do not automatically promote, a local receipt-backed pre-publication check over serialized adapter bytes.
Candidate check requires every serialized LoRA A/B tensor to be at least 2-D, non-empty, immutable-byte readable, exact-base bound and successfully reloadable.
Any fail-closed publication behavior is an SZL policy decision requiring separate code review and tests.

stages.name: failure-and-rollback
acceptance: Exercise malformed shard, explicit-state-dict, save-load, byte-readback, cancellation and failure paths.
Verify rollback leaves existing admitted publisher behavior and artifacts unchanged.
Partial evidence cannot become publication or model qualification.

claimBoundary: This file prepares evaluation only. The upstream PEFT warning does not certify adapter completeness or deny malformed writes, and no SZL fail-closed publication policy is admitted by this plan.
